Download Linux Voice issue 8 CC BY-SA 3.0 (Linux Voice is a Linux and open source magazine (print and digital) which began publication in the UK in 2014. It is sold on newsstands around the world.)
I am a subscriber and it's a great publication.

I was pleasantly surprised to find they actually followed through on their promise to a) CC licence back issues (9 months after release I think) and b) Pay a portion of their profits to FLOSS projects, voted on by the readers.

I really hope they can keep it up, they are talented writers and have found a way to balance articles that suck people in, along with drier content that's just as useful and serves as a reference that can be used in the longer term.

The back up your data tutorial is pretty neatly explained. I would recommend using duplicity, which does pretty much what the article describes automatically plus has backends for connecting through various common channels, but knowing how to do it manually helps a lot with the understanding.
